customer_oncall: Heads-up — multiple customers started getting intermittent 403s on SAML POSTs to our ACS after we rolled out stricter HSTS + CDN host canonicalization at ~13:48 UTC.

customer_oncall: Representative log: "SAML assertion recipient mismatch: expected 'https://app.redwood.example/saml/acs' got 'https://edge-proxy.local/saml/acs'" — same IdP, same assertion, only started after the proxy change.

support_jane: Can you paste a minimal repro (curl) and a redacted SAMLResponse? Also need the IdP metadata URL and whether they rotated signing certs recently.

customer_oncall: Repro steps:
1) IdP POSTs SAMLResponse to our ACS
2) CDN/proxy rewrites Host to internal edge host for routing
3) ACS rejects with 403 recipient validation failure

Curl repro (redacted):
```
curl -i -X POST \
  -H "Host: edge-proxy.local" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded" \
  --data "SAMLResponse=<REDACTED_BASE64>" \
  "https://app.redwood.example/saml/acs"
```

Response: 403 and server log: "Recipient validation failed: expected https://app.redwood.example/saml/acs but got https://edge-proxy.local/saml/acs"

support_jane: That lines up — the SAML library validates Recipient/Audience against the effective request URL and the Host header matters. Do we have a proxy rule that sets Host to $server_name or rewrites it? Also confirm whether IdP cert rotation happened.

infra_miguel: Our rollout added a canonicalization rule; nginx snippet we pushed to CDN origin edge:
```
proxy_set_header Host $server_name; # this caused the rewrite
proxy_pass https://app_backend;
```
We should've kept $http_host for forwarded posts. Some proxies default to $server_name which will change the request URL used by validation.

sre_linda: Also check IdP signing certs — rotated certs + intermediate chain changes can surface at the same time and confuse triage. From the edge run:
```
openssl s_client -connect idp.example:443 -showcerts
```
and confirm IdP metadata still advertises the same EntityID and ACS URL. Note: some SAML parsers pick the first KeyDescriptor; key ordering matters.

cse_tom: Quick customer workaround: preserve the original Host for /saml/acs or explicitly rewrite it back to canonical host when proxying. Example nginx fix:
```
location /saml/acs {
  proxy_set_header Host app.redwood.example;
  proxy_pass https://app_backend;
}
```
If they can't change proxy, platform can add a trusted-proxy mapping to canonicalize recipient before validation (we can fast-track a config flag).

support_jane: Agreed. Short-term: tell customers to preserve Host on SAML POSTs. Medium-term: add a trusted-proxies host-mapping flag in ACS config and document the proxy pitfalls.

customer_oncall: We tested changing the proxy to preserve Host and 403s stopped immediately. The impacted IdP also rotated signing certs yesterday but the chain looked valid on inspection.

infra_miguel: Rolling change to revert to proxy_set_header Host $http_host on the SAML path now.

deploy-bot: deployment started: proxy-cfg/2026-03-17T16:02:12Z

deploy-bot: deployment succeeded: proxy-cfg/2026-03-17T16:07:01Z

support_jane: Monitoring shows no new 403s for 40m; customer confirms stable. Action items:
- Customer: keep Host preserved for /saml/acs (confirmed) :white_check_mark:
- Infra: deploy proxy change to prod and monitor :arrow_up:
- Platform: add KB note about Host rewrite vs SAML recipient validation :memo:
- Eng/Product: evaluate trusted-proxy canonicalization flag for ACS (short-term patch)

support_jane: I'll draft a KB and paste a small test snippet for customers. Will close if stable tomorrow. :eyes:
